classification: pre-registered PIT trade-level re-audit of the frozen hold-30 candidate; research-only, no parameter search
question: After R381 repaired HS300 membership and B-sleeve industry lineage, do the frozen hold-30 trades still pass concentration, execution and capacity gates when trade P&L is weighted by the actual portfolio path and industry labels are resolved as of each entry date?

trigger.reason: R381 repaired portfolio inputs but did not rerun the trade-level audit. Inspection also found that R380 concentration aggregation consumed unscaled pnl_amount even though scale_trades had produced portfolio_pnl_amount, and it mapped every trade to one current industry snapshot. R380 trade-level concentration therefore cannot be carried forward as the current audit.

pit_industry.lookup: latest Shenwan effective_date not later than the trade entry date

frozen_design.portfolio: monthly 60-day inverse-vol risk parity, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity volatility target, 60-day overlay at 15%, one-third equity-weight cap, gold 200-day trend defensive bucket

audit_method.curve_reconciliation: Rerun all A, B30, B20 and three C cohorts from R381 inputs; current portfolio annual, Sharpe, MDD, recent and sealed metrics must reproduce r381_pit_data_audit.json at absolute tolerance 1e-9.
audit_method.trade_count_reconciliation: The R381 run summary freezes A at 290 trades, B30 at 732 and combined C at 2467, for 3489 total trades.
audit_method.pnl_basis: portfolio_pnl_amount, after applying the holding-period average final defensive equity weight and sleeve weight; raw sleeve-account pnl_amount is not used for portfolio concentration.
audit_method.industry_basis: Each trade is assigned the latest PIT industry effective on its entry date; missing labels remain unknown and count against coverage.
audit_method.capacity_basis: Portfolio entry and exit notionals at the trade date, revalued linearly across declared portfolio capital levels against actual daily amount.
audit_method.execution_basis: B30 hard entry and exit miss counters from the current engine, plus blocked-exit days from the rebuilt B30 trades.

concentration.reason: Retain the existing v2 concentration policy; the 99% industry coverage floor is the same data-coverage floor used by R381.

execution.reason: Retain R380 execution limits; no-slot and same-day-reentry counters are strategy behaviour, not failed execution.

decision_rules: Curve and trade-count reconciliation must pass before trade-level audit values are used for a candidate decision.
Concentration must use portfolio_pnl_amount and entry-date PIT industry labels; do not reuse R380 concentration fields as current evidence.
All concentration, execution and capacity gates must pass.
If any reconciliation or audit gate fails, retain the result as research-only and do not advance it to paper trading.
No parameter changes, best-cell selection, leverage, paper target, orders or production enablement are permitted.
known_limits: The Shenwan workbook provides effective dates but not a complete publication-vintage history.
Industry code first two digits are only an L1 proxy, and 99.09% symbol-day coverage is a lower bound rather than complete classification.
The industry group mean used to build the B-sleeve field still uses the 459-symbol historical alt_hs300 union.
Daily amount is a liquidity proxy; intraday depth, order-book impact and market-impact curves are unavailable.
The sealed window remains one approximately 17-month period.
This is a re-audit of the same frozen candidate, not an independent alpha sample.
